auth_intro: Sign in with an email code to keep your place at the table.
auth_code_hint: Eight digits. The code expires in 15 minutes.
auth_send_error: Could not send a code. Check your connection and try again.
auth_code_error: That code is invalid or has expired. Try again or request a new code.
auth_return_hint: You can close the app and return while your session remains valid.
auth_sign_out_error: Could not sign out. Please try again.
auth_identity_error: Could not verify your session. Check your connection, or sign out and try again.
games_unavailable: This game is unavailable. Sign in with the email that holds your seat.
games_saved: Your game and seat are saved. Return from any device with the same email.
games_create_error: Could not create the game. Check your connection and try again.
games_list_error: Could not load your games. Check your connection.
games_empty: No unfinished games yet. Create your first table.
invite_link_hint: Share this link. You approve each new seat before they can see the game.
invite_intro: Request a seat. The host must approve you before you can enter the game.
invite_pending: Your seat request is waiting for host approval.
invite_rejected: The host declined your seat request.
invite_unavailable: This invitation is unavailable. Ask the host for a link.
invite_error: Could not complete that request. The table may be full. Try again.
